coverage: Monotonic live timing and browser monitoring

findings.finding: Holding control cadence fixed while changing physics decimation isolates solver-step sensitivity; separate wall pacing and live observation can expose slow execution without altering simulated dynamics.
findings.relevance: Measured flight-controller testing and live inspection
findings.direction_alignment: The maintainer requested realistic physics tests and real-time monitoring after merging the numerical audit.
findings.opportunity_or_risk: A live display must not imply completed validation or hard real-time execution; the unresolved yaw finding limits convergence claims.
findings.engineering_cost: One bounded flight study with read-only local monitoring
findings.roadmap_delta: AL-011 adds observed fixed-cadence missions; AL-010 remains open
findings.verification_needed: Three frequencies and three seeds, exact shared wind, unchanged mission gates, live GPU browser observation, stale/error/security tests

overall_recommendation: Measure closed-loop sensitivity and execution timing while retaining the independent yaw-refinement finding.
evidence_gaps: No calibrated sensor or aerodynamic model
